camel_example: aliyun ndr DescribeProtoLogHistograms --region cn-hangzhou --Site global --ToTime 1788395400000 --FromTime 1788393600000 --LogFilter '{"logicOp":"and","logFilterItems":[{"logField":"src_ip","op":"=","value":"192.0.2.10"}]}' --Interval 60000 --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Counts protocol logs within each time interval of a specified time range, suitable for rendering quantity trends. The returned FromTime and ToTime represent the boundaries of each time interval, in milliseconds. The actual interval width is determined by the returned results
description_zh: 统计指定时间范围内各时间段的协议日志数量，适用于绘制数量趋势。返回的 FromTime 和 ToTime 为各时间段的边界，单位为毫秒；时间段宽度以实际返回结果为准
name: DescribeProtoLogHistograms

parameters.help_en: The log filter condition, specified as a JSON string. logicOp is set to and or or. logFilterItems is an array of conditions, where each item contains logField, op, and value, with value specified as a string. logFilters can contain nested condition groups of the same structure. If this parameter is not specified, no field-level filtering is applied. Available fields and operators can be obtained by calling the ListProtoLogSupportIndex operation
parameters.help_zh: 日志过滤条件，使用 JSON 字符串。logicOp 为 and 或 or；logFilterItems 为条件数组，每项包含 logField、op、value，value 使用字符串；logFilters 可嵌套同结构的条件组。不传时不附加字段过滤。可用字段和运算符通过 ListProtoLogSupportIndex 获取
parameters.name: log_filter

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. If this parameter is not specified or is set to 0, the time 30 minutes before the current time is used. The value must not be later than ToTime. Specify both the start time and end time together
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。不传或传 0 时，使用当前时间前 30 分钟；须不晚于 ToTime。建议同时传入开始和结束时间
parameters.name: from_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. If this parameter is not specified or is set to 0, the current time is used. The value must not be earlier than FromTime. If FromTime equals ToTime, the system queries the time range from 1 second before ToTime to ToTime
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。不传或传 0 时，使用当前时间；须不早于 FromTime。当 FromTime 与 ToTime 相等时，系统按 ToTime 前 1 秒至 ToTime 的时间范围查询
parameters.name: to_time

parameters.help_en: The bucket width for statistics, in milliseconds. If specified, the value must be greater than or equal to 60000. In the legacy log storage mode, logs are bucketed based on this parameter, and you must specify this parameter. In the new log storage mode, Simple Log Service automatically determines the bucket width, and this parameter does not control the actual bucket width. For compatibility across storage modes, always specify a value of at least 60000 and use the FromTime and ToTime values in the response as the actual boundaries
parameters.help_zh: 统计分桶宽度，单位为毫秒，传入时必须大于或等于 60000。旧版日志存储模式按本参数分桶，且调用时需传入；新版日志存储模式由日志服务自动分桶，本参数不决定实际分桶宽度。为兼容不同存储模式，建议始终传入不小于 60000 的值，并以响应中的 FromTime 和 ToTime 为准
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The log query site. You can obtain valid values from the Sites field returned by the DescribeDeliveryDestination operation. In multi-site scenarios, the specified site is used preferentially if it is active. If no site is specified or the specified site is unavailable, the system automatically selects an active site. If only one active site exists, that site is used. If no active site exists, the LogDeliveryNotOpen error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 日志查询站点，可从 DescribeDeliveryDestination 返回的 Sites 中获取。多站点场景下优先使用有效的指定站点；未指定或指定站点不可用时，系统自动选择可用站点。仅有一个可用站点时使用该站点；无可用站点时返回 LogDeliveryNotOpen
parameters.name: site

Data.description_en: The statistical results of protocol log count trends
Data.description_zh: 协议日志数量趋势统计结果

List.description_en: The list of log counts grouped by time interval
List.description_zh: 按时间段划分的日志数量列表

FromTime.description_en: The start time of the time interval. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
FromTime.description_zh: 该时间段的开始时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒

ProtoLogCount.description_en: The number of protocol logs that match the query conditions within the bucket
ProtoLogCount.description_zh: 该分桶内符合查询条件的协议日志条数

ToTime.description_en: The end time of the time interval. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. Use the actual returned boundaries for rendering. The end time of the last time interval may exceed the requested end time
ToTime.description_zh: 该时间段的结束时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。应使用实际返回的边界绘图；最后一个时间段的结束时间可能超出请求结束时间

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. This value is empty when the request succeeds. The example shows a scenario where the query range is invalid
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；请求成功时为空。示例展示查询范围无效场景

Message.description_en: The result message of the request. This value describes the error cause when the request fails. The example shows a scenario where the query range is invalid
Message.description_zh: 请求结果信息；失败时用于说明错误原因。示例展示查询范围无效场景

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate this request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次请求

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
